name: phoneinfoga-phone-osint
title: PhoneInfoga Cloud - International Phone Number OSINT | Bulk
description: Scan international phone numbers with PhoneInfoga: validate format, identify country, and generate OSINT footprint URLs across social media, reputation sites, disposable-number databases, and paste/document searches. Wraps the 16K-star OSINT tool by sundowndev.

keyValueStore.title: Run summary
keyValueStore.description: The OUTPUT record: how many numbers were scanned, failed or invalid, the scanners that were off (with which were skipped only because credentials were missing), and every number that was not charged with its reason. The status message carries the counts and at most the first three reasons.

summary.title: Run summary (OUTPUT)
summary.description: Counts per outcome, the disabled scanners, the scanners skipped for missing credentials, and every number not charged with its reason code.
